ABS Outstanding : As reported by the Owner's Representative, two (2) ventilation fans of Cargo Hold Ventilation System were malfunctioned as listed below, the deficiencies could not be rectified due to no spare parts onboard.
- Cargo Hold No. 01: M101 exhaust fan motor was burnt out.
- Cargo Hold No. 02: M201 exhaust fan blades were damaged.
As reported by the Owner's Representative, the spare parts will be connected onboard when the vessel calls Asia ports around 24-Oct-2026 to 03-Nov-2026.
Remote Survey was carried out at this time, per authorization email of Singapore MPA dated 08 September 2026.
Following documents/photos submitted by owner’s representative were reviewed and considered satisfactory:

- 
Risk Assessment with control measures prepared by Master.

- 
Master’s Statement of Fact for damaged cargo hold ventilation fans.

- 
Damage report.

- 
Photos of all the defective cargo hold fans are to be safely isolated from use.

- 
Entry of the defective cargo hold fans is to be recorded in ship’s log book.

- 
Spare parts arrangement

- 
Master’s Statement of Fact to confirm the followings:

- 
All shipboard personnel were briefed and made aware of the defective cargo hold fans

- 
All other cargo hold fans are regularly inspected and operationally tested in good working order

- 
All cargo holds natural ventilators remained in open position subjected to weather conditions as deemed necessary by the Master

- 
Entry of the affected cargo holds are restricted and only permitted upon Master’s order and proper ventilation carried out prior to entry

- 
All crew were properly trained and familiar with the use of portable oxygen/gas analyzers

- 
Sufficient walkie-talkies are available on board as means of communication

- 
The competent Port State authorities to be notified of the defective power ventilators when the vessel calls at foreign ports

As per authorization of Flag Administration, a short-term Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate valid until 10 November 2026 was issued at this time, pending rectification of defective two (2) ventilation fans in Cargo Holds.

ABS Outstanding : The vessel's managing company requested a remote survey via email to report the No.1 PA/GA Control System malfunction.
In accordance with the Singapore MPA Shipping Circular No. 10 of 2025 and ABS survey process instructions, the survey was completed remotely based on digital data and information provided by the Owner and the vessel. The following items were verified and found satisfactory:
- Normal operation of the No.2 PA/GA Control System.
The following documents were reviewed:
- Master’s attestation
- Risk assessment
- Crew awareness records
- Videos and photos demonstrating the No.2 PA/GA Control System operation and system status
- Abandon drill record
- Maintenance records of PA/GA system
- Repair Plan
- Company's confirmation of compliance with Singapore MPA Shipping Circular No. 10 of 2025
Upon satisfactory verification of above, a Statutory Condition has been imposed in accordance with Shipping Circular No. 10 of 2025, permitting the vessel to continue operating with the defective No.1 PA/GA Control System, pending repairing at the earliest opportunity but no later than 
12 October 2026
. A Short-Term Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate valid until 
12 October 2026
 has been issued accordingly.
The Master has been notified of the following in accordance with Singapore MPA Shipping Circular No. 10 of 2025:
- Taking into account of the malfunction equipment when planning and executing a voyage to a port where the repair or replace will be carried out.
- Notifying the relevant competent authority when calling to a foreign port as per SOLAS regulation I/11(C).
